meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把贴入的文章、笔记或话题做成一部“无脸解说”视频:规划讲解脚本,逐帧设计画面(排版/抽象图形/图表),生成配音配乐,最后渲染为 mp4;不抓取网站或真实素材。
howto.when: 当你把文章、笔记或话题文本交给 Claude、要求做成解说视频时触发;典型用途是概念讲解、教程、清单文等。若意图不明会转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇文章做成一段 60 秒的无脸解说视频。
say.note: 会先确认简报,再生成分镜脚本和视频。

say.text: 把这段笔记做成解说视频,用男声旁白。
say.note: 会按你选的音色生成配音并继续制作。

say.text: 按这份大纲做一条清单体解说视频。
say.note: 会匹配对应结构并推进到最终渲染。

howto.what_en: Turns a pasted article, notes, or topic into a faceless explainer video: it plans a teaching storyboard, invents visuals per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz), generates narration/music, and renders a final mp4. No website capture or real footage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give it a body of text (article, notes, topic, brief) and ask for an explainer video — topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. If intent is unclear it routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a 60-second faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It confirms the brief, then builds the storyboard and video.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video from these notes, using a male voice.
say_en.note: Narration voice is matched and audio is generated.

say_en.text: Use this outline for a listicle-style explainer video.
say_en.note: It picks a matching structure and proceeds to render.
